description: Video editor with multi-track schema-2 projects, exact rational frame rates, keyframes, speed mapping, captions, personal narration approval and recoverable native export.

tools.name: read_video_project
tools.description: 读取旧制作工程/声音/任务，或仅传 editor 读取完整 v2 工程/原生任务。editor.view=project 支持 documentView=document/defaults、identity/path/offset/limit/format；view=jobs 支持 jobIds/offset/limit/path/pageOffset/format。完整翻页到 nextOffset=null，大值沿 path 展开，极长元数据用 format=json 拼接。v2 是 240000 ticks/秒及有理帧率，不是旧30fps投影。见 editor-v2 技能。

view.description: Defaults to project; jobs returns full task results, voices reads the live catalog.

jobIds.description: Only for view=jobs. Reuse IDs returned by production tools.

path.description: Exact JSON pointer returned by a previous page; empty reads the root. Escape / as ~1 and ~ as ~0. Prototype paths are rejected.

format.description: Default tree. json pages the exact serialized value as UTF-16 text; use for complete metadata including exceptionally long object keys. Keep the same identity while joining pages.

path.description: Exact JSON pointer returned by a previous page; empty reads the root. Escape / as ~1 and ~ as ~0. Prototype paths are rejected.

format.description: Default tree. json pages the exact serialized value as UTF-16 text; use for complete metadata including exceptionally long object keys. Keep the same identity while joining pages.

tools.name: propose_video_edit
tools.description: Validate and present an atomic edit proposal for user review; does not apply edits. Use the projectId and requestToken from the active video editing task to prevent stale submissions. Legacy operations use integer frames at 30 fps with baseRevision; the editor branch {title, explanation?, editor:{identity, steps}} uses the same steps and identity as apply_video_edit's editor branch and is required for real footage, extra tracks, titles or transitions that the legacy project omits.

cuts.description: During an active AI rough-cut request, only new review candidates for the current source batch. Does not replace existing markers or add clips to the timeline.

tools.name: apply_video_edit
tools.description: 应用旧授权方案，或用 editor 分支操作完整 v2 工程。editor:{identity,label,steps} 使用共享剪辑、字幕、序列、多机位规则，保存成功才发布一修订，可一步撤销；限100步骤/1000操作/256KiB。另可用互斥的 editor.separation、editor.enhancement、editor.alignment、editor.sync 运行声音分离、降噪/响度、真实声音对齐和开放工程同步；后台回执不等于完成，读状态后再应用候选。禁止伪造资源、改审批或解锁；录音/制作忙锁仍适用，旁白依赖变化退回审阅。身份过期须重新规划。同步版本采用保留快照并重置剪辑撤销栈。参数和分页规则详见 editor-v2 技能。

tools.name: prepare_video_assets
tools.description: Queue durable local preparation (inspection, preview proxy, thumbnail, waveform, silence and scene detection) and optional transcription; returns job IDs. Does not edit the sequence. Requires the projectId and requestToken from the current automatic production request; stale task writes are rejected.

tools.name: get_video_transcript
tools.description: Read a page of actual speech transcript with source seconds (start/end), not sequence time. Use pagination to cover the source.

tools.name: get_video_analysis
tools.description: Read paginated source silence intervals or shot boundary timestamps. These are detector observations, not semantic judgments.

tools.name: inspect_video_frame
tools.description: Inspect an actual image or video frame. Returns a JPEG image content block, at most 640 pixels. seconds refers to source time. Sample relevant frames before judging visual contents.

tools.name: create_video_scene
tools.description: Generate saved HyperFrames source and render a real MP4 chapter card or explainer. Returns a durable job; wait for succeeded, then read the project to obtain the generated asset ID. Requires the projectId and requestToken from the current automatic production request; stale task writes are rejected.

tools.name: render_video_project
tools.description: 旧授权制作或完整v2导出均先返回accepted/operationId/preparing，真实任务建立后才提供jobId。旧请求保持projectId/baseRevision/requestToken审批；用read_video_project({view:"jobs",jobIds:[operationId]})读operations和jobs。v2传editor:{identity,sequenceId,profileId,requestId?}，先保存并检查身份，再用read_video_project({editor:{view:"jobs",path:"/submissions",format:"json"}})查准备回执，取得真实jobId后查询任务。同请求复用回执，不为轮询重提；v2取消传editor:{identity,action:"cancel",operationId}。仅succeeded且真实输出验证后才算完成。

requestId.description: 同一逻辑请求使用稳定ID；重试保持ID，不得用于不同版本或预设。

tools.name: create_video_voiceover
tools.description: Generate a saved narration asset using models and voices from read_video_project(view=voices). Requires current projectId/requestToken. After success, use actual duration to fit visuals and attach the complete audio with audio-add. For Audio8/Qwen cloning, use voiceId=reference, a current project referenceAssetId (3–30 seconds), verbatim referenceText, and at most 2000 characters of new speech. Local clone recordings stay on this computer.

instructions.description: Delivery style, only when the selected model supports instructions.

referenceAssetId.description: Current project audio asset ID for the user’s own 3–30 second recording; audio8-tts or qwen3-tts. The panel resolves its durable Host media ID.

referenceText.description: Verbatim transcript of the reference recording; required with referenceAssetId for audio8-tts or qwen3-tts. This is distinct from text to synthesize.

tools.name: prepare_video_voice
tools.description: Generate one short real voice sample using the selected model and reference. Accepts 1–120 Unicode characters; saves a durable audio asset with speech recipe and never places it on the timeline. Allowed during initialization only for the user-selected voice configuration. Wait for succeeded, then read the actual asset. Setup readiness does not establish personal voice similarity.

instructions.description: Delivery style, only when the selected model supports instructions.

referenceAssetId.description: Current project audio asset ID for the user’s own 3–30 second recording; audio8-tts or qwen3-tts. The panel resolves its durable Host media ID.

referenceText.description: Verbatim transcript of the reference recording; required with referenceAssetId for audio8-tts or qwen3-tts. This is distinct from text to synthesize.

tools.name: extract_video_reference
tools.description: Extract the user-selected 3–30 second source interval into a real durable WAV reference asset. Rough-cut markers do not trim the source file. Takes current project audio/video asset ID and 30 fps half-open source frames; wait for succeeded and read the resulting audio asset before preparing a voice sample. Does not alter the timeline. During initialization the interval must match the user-selected voice configuration.

tools.name: setup_video_tts
tools.description: Install and verify the selected Edge, Kokoro, Audio8 or Qwen engine when requested or selected during initialization. Models and fixed dependencies belong to the Panel. Native tasks continue after closing the panel. Query read_video_project(view=jobs), then refresh read_video_project(view=voices); a queued setup is not a ready voice. Audio8/Qwen initialization currently requires Apple Silicon macOS.

tools.name: enhance_video_audio
tools.description: Create a full-length denoised and loudness-normalized WAV from an original audio/video asset. Preserves the original and returns a new source after job completion. Does not place/mute tracks automatically; align source in/out/start frames and mute original when applying.

tools.name: set_video_script
tools.description: Save editable narration text at the current revision and populate the voiceover editor without changing recorded speech. Draft mode requires finish=false, followed by footage, temporary captions and workflow review. Unavailable during narration alignment, which preserves the approved script. Use finish=true only for a script-editing-only request.

tools.name: finish_video_tts_setup
tools.description: Finish an installation-only request after its tts-setup job succeeds with a real synthesis verification. Use only when the user asked for setup, without a video deliverable. Does not cancel unfinished work.
